name: vehicle speed
definition_status: Beauvais Vu=constrained carriage speed ft/s; distinct from total V

name: crosswind speed
definition_status: Beauvais Vv=perpendicular tunnel crossflow ft/s; no longitudinal wind term

name: relative-wind yaw angle
definition_status: Beauvais psi=atan(Vv/Vu), deg nose-right convention; Hucho beta=aerodynamic yaw; symbol names not transferable

name: vehicle heading angle
definition_status: Hucho p899 psi=vehicle yaw in deg; not aerodynamic beta

name: aerodynamic yaw moment
definition_status: Beauvais CN=(CF1-CF2)d/x about0.513x aft nose; Hucho cN=N/(q_inf Ay l) aboutxs; source-specific
